title: 从2D图像与细胞群体统计学习3D生物物理细胞属性
summary: 提出群体监督框架，将单张2D红细胞图像映射到潜在生物物理量并聚合为平均红细胞体积、红细胞分布宽度和平均血红蛋白量，在六个设备上报告与Sysmex分析仪的相关性达0.86-0.98。
summary_en: A population-supervised framework maps single 2D red-cell images to latent biophysical quantities and aggregates them to mean corpuscular volume, red-cell distribution width and mean corpuscular haemoglobin, achieving Pearson correlations of 0.86-0.98 against a Sysmex analyser across six devices.
